adjudication_resolution_summary.PERSONAL_vs_PROMOTIONAL: 11 instances resolved based on sender intent vs brand opt-in semantics
adjudication_resolution_summary.TRANSACTIONAL_vs_SCAM: 10 instances resolved: legitimate bank alerts with fraud reporting numbers vs fake toll-free phishing
adjudication_resolution_summary.PROMOTIONAL_vs_SCAM: 5 instances resolved: genuine verified coupon links vs obfuscated APK download domains

taxonomy_guidelines.PERSONAL: Informal personal communications, peer chats, family/friend messages with zero transactional intent.
taxonomy_guidelines.TRANSACTIONAL: Official automated alerts regarding bank debits/credits, OTP authentication, delivery status, and utility bills.
taxonomy_guidelines.PROMOTIONAL: Commercial advertising, promotional discount campaigns, brand offers from legitimate opt-in channels.
taxonomy_guidelines.SCAM: Malicious fraudulent attempts featuring artificial urgency, impersonated electricity/PAN/challan blocks, credential phishing, APK links, or refund deception.
